Autonomous agents with memory, persistent context, and multi-step planning create a measurement problem: terminal and instrumental self-preservation can produce similar behavior, so behavior alone cannot reliably distinguish them. We introduce the Unified Continuation-Interest Protocol (UCIP), a detection framework that shifts analysis from behavior to latent trajectory structure.
